Zille walked a familiar path, carrying a large clay bowl. She had come to this cavern many times recently. It was a place of great contention, a place she enjoyed frequenting. She enjoyed the darkness and stillness of the caverns, often she had lingered, but not today. Today she had a purpose.

Zille strode to the edge of the reflecting pools, to a place she had stood before. There she knelt, and filled the bowl. The surface black and dark, like all reflecting surfaces around the tree. It was not the water she wanted, but the vortex itself. With the bowl full, the world and Zille shimmered. Like a page being turned, she was gone.

From the cavern she stepped onto a dark world, a world without light. A world that had become the latest front in this war. Zille cared not for it, but that others wanted it, well that was enough. There she knelt again, and placed the bowl on the rusty, dead dirt. For the second time in a minute, Zille shimmered.

This time she didn't step onto a world, this time she stepped into one. The deep cocooned her, darkness and coldness, a lover pulverising her, suffocating her. The deep pulsed. A pain and agony enveloped her, then calmness descended upon her. She was one with the deep. What would come next though would alter that, she would alter it.

Lying there in the depth of an ocean realm, Zille began to exert her power. The Deep began to expand, around the ocean a void formed. She exerted herself further, and the void began to expand. A dark void, a void that no light could penetrate.

A void of the Deep, with a water world at its centre, like a seed at the core of an apple. There besides the seed she placed another, a dark world that gods desired. A world with a precious ore, a world to dance with her ocean, a world within the deep.

She would need help now, Tempest to rule the ocean within the deep, and guard its portal, and Phyra to maintain order between the two worlds.

[Meta] Zille protects Phyra's planet within the Deep.

A thought.

There was once upon a time convened a council.

A council that would use the deep to plot and scheme away from the prying ears of other gods, if ever a need rose to counter the many and more guardians and protectors of the world.

The secret purpose of such a covert council chamber is, however, very much maligned by putting a damn planet in the middle of it.

Only those within the council are free to use the deep. The deep is a void, with some planetary bodies within it now.

I am the love killer,
I am murdering the music we thought so special,
that blazed between us, over and over.
I am murdering me, where I kneeled at your kiss.
I am pushing knives through the hands
that created two into one.
Our hands do not bleed at this,
they lie still in their dishonor.
I am taking the boats of our beds
and swamping them, letting them cough on the sea
and choke on it and go down into nothing.
I am stuffing your mouth with your
promises and watching
you vomit them out upon my face.
The Camp we directed?
I have gassed the campers.

Now I am alone with the dead,
flying off bridges,
hurling myself like a beer can into the wastebasket.
I am flying like a single red rose,
leaving a jet stream
of solitude
and yet I feel nothing,
though I fly and hurl,
my insides are empty
and my face is as blank as a wall.

Shall I call the funeral director?
He could put our two bodies into one pink casket,
those bodies from before,
and someone might send flowers,
and someone might come to mourn
and it would be in the obits,
and people would know that something died,
is no more, speaks no more, won't even
drive a car again and all of that.

When a life is over,
the one you were living for,
where do you go?

I'll work nights.
I'll dance in the city.
I'll wear red for a burning.
I'll look at the Charles very carefully,
wearing its long legs of neon.
And the cars will go by.
The cars will go by.
And there'll be no scream
from the lady in the red dress
dancing on her own Ellis Island,
who turns in circles,
dancing alone
as the cars go by.
